cues.en: The goal of this tutorial video is to show you how to create special functions that you can implant into PyTorch models.
cues.zh: 這部教學影片，要展示如何建立能植入 PyTorch 模型的特殊函式。

cues.en: In principle, you can do basically anything you want inside those functions with the internals of the model, including transforming them, visualizing them, or changing them.
cues.zh: 原則上，函式內幾乎可以對模型內部做任何事，包括轉換、視覺化或修改。

cues.en: What we are going to do with these hooks for this and the next several sections, is to extract the activations from inside the model.
cues.zh: 本節與接下來幾節，要用這些 hook，也就是掛鉤函式，擷取模型內部的活化。

cues.en: This is a vital approach for anything related to interpretability, or really any kind of investigative work into the internal workings of LMS.
cues.zh: 對可解釋性，或任何探究 LLM 內部運作的研究，這是非常重要的方式。

cues.en: So you already know how to get all the weights, the trainable parameters from anywhere in the model.
cues.zh: 你已經知道，如何從模型任何地方取得權重、可訓練參數。

cues.en: Of course, you know how to get the final output logits at the end of the model feedforward process
cues.zh: 當然，也知道如何取得模型前饋程序最後的輸出 logits，

cues.en: that's simply the output of the model when you input a sequence of tokens.
cues.zh: 就是輸入一段 token 序列時，模型的輸出。

cues.en: And I have previously showed you how to get the outputs of different transformer blocks using the output hidden States option.
cues.zh: 先前也展示過，使用 output_hidden_states 選項，取得不同 Transformer 區塊的輸出。

cues.en: But so far in this course, I haven't taught you how to get the activations from inside a transformer block.
cues.zh: 但到目前，還沒教過如何取得 Transformer 區塊內部的活化。

cues.en: For example, the individual activations matrices from the attention or MLP layers.
cues.zh: 例如，注意力或 MLP 層中的個別活化矩陣。

cues.en: And that is what you do with hooks.
cues.zh: 這就是 hook 的用途。

cues.en: Once you learn how to create and implant hooks, you can access literally any number you want from anywhere in the model.
cues.zh: 一旦學會建立、植入 hook，就能從模型任何地方，存取任何想要的數字。

cues.en: Now, there isn't really any theory in this lecture, so let me just tell you what we're going to do.
cues.zh: 這堂沒有什麼理論，直接介紹要做什麼，

cues.en: In the code demo.
cues.zh: 也就是程式示範。

cues.zh: 會展示如何在模型中植入 hook，擷取 Q 矩陣活化。

cues.zh: 這裡 Q 活化沒有什麼獨特、特殊之處。

cues.en: You can do this with any other activations anywhere in the model.
cues.zh: 也能對模型任何地方的其他活化這樣做。

cues.en: I'm just using the Q activations from a particular layer as an example.
cues.zh: 只是以某層的 Q 活化作例子。

cues.en: Anyway, here you see what a hook function looks like.
cues.zh: 這裡看到 hook 函式的樣子。

cues.en: I'll explain what all of these variables mean in the Python demo, but basically the idea is that I

cues.en: There are a few other important things to know about hooks, like whether the data get replaced or concatenated
cues.zh: 關於 hook，還有其他重要事情，例如每次新的前向傳播時，資料是被取代還是串接，

cues.en: each time you run a new forward pass in the model, and also how to remove hooks that you've already implanted.
cues.zh: 以及如何移除已植入的 hook。

cues.en: It turns out that hooks can lead to a bit of a performance decrease, depending on how much code happens inside the hook.
cues.zh: hook 可能稍微降低效能，取決於裡面執行多少程式。

cues.en: So in general, you really only want to have hooks in the model when you actually need them.
cues.zh: 一般而言，真的需要時，才在模型中保留 hook。
